Indian Tourists Killed in Vietnam Boat Accident

A boat carrying Indian tourists capsized off the coast of Vietnam, resulting in at least 15 deaths and several injuries. The incident occurred near Phu Quoc island, where 21 people were rescued, including two in critical condition.
